fact: Morocco's Open Government Partnership commitment page, undated and filed at 2020 by inference, lists setting up a national data policy as part of an August 2018 to August 2020 commitment, with drafting of the public-data strategy and regulation (May to October 2019) shown as in progress at 90%; as_of is the last milestone, March 2020.

Kassimi and Salam's article, published December 2024 (no more precise date given for the finding), states the Moroccan government has not yet formalised a specific public data governance policy and that there is no unified national data governance strategy.

The same article, published December 2024 (no more precise date given for the finding), states that there is no national data committee or regional data committees, and few administrations have a dedicated data governance unit.
